scope: Proposition 5.2 (Individual nesting amplitudes) of the manuscript “Natural Occupation Measures for Critical Square-Lattice FK Interfaces” (preprints/Natural-Occupation-Measures-for-Critical-Square-Lattice-FK-Interfaces-October-5-2026/natural-occupation-measures-critical-square-lattice-fk-interfaces.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d0fd0c30ada6a1f0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 36. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is ε0 > 0 and a nonvanishing holomor- phic function a(t) near [−ε0, ε0], positive for real t, such that Fn(v(t)) = a(t)nβ(t) (1 + o(1)) locally uniformly on a complex neighborhood of that interval. The limit uses the fixed cutoff and rounding in the definition of Fn. No rate is asserted for this individual amplitude.
